title: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, fix the reach-gate's poolDigest so it grades a produced shape's real content ins
description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, fix the reach-gate's poolDigest so it grades a produced shape's real content instead of a provenance pointer. In the poolDigest construction — the `poolImpulses.filter(...).map(...)` block that renders each impulse as `- ${shape}: ${content}` (near the comment "Pool content goes first so substantive earlier outputs survive the length cap") — before rendering, detect when an impulse's content is an object carrying an `executionId` (a `{producedBy, executionId}` provenance stub) and, when present, substitute the resolved content from `reachContentDigests.get(executionId)` (which is already stored in `- shape: content` form); otherwise fall back to rendering the stub exactly as today. This must fail open: if there is no executionId or no entry in reachContentDigests, behavior is unchanged. The goal is that a shellResult produced by a vessel-resolve satisfier contributes its actual stdout (e.g. a count) to the graded digest, not the pointer, so extractEmittedNumbers can read it. Do not change reconcileDerivations or its call site.
